subject: 🌎 Last call to join us at Axios House Climate Week and UNGA | Sept. 21 - 23
body_text:
96 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  RSVP to Axios House 
 Hello Axios insider,  

  

 
 📣 This is a last call to register for Axios House.  Don't miss your chance to join us for three days of newsworthy events at Climate Week and the UN General Assembly .

 

   
 🚨Seats are filling fast. RSVP to Axios House 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for a conversation featuring leaders across business, government and technology to discuss how innovation and policy can help meet growing energy needs.  

 

 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 10:00am - 11:30am ET 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for an event exploring the role of culture and influence in shaping the climate conversation. 

  

  

 

 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 4:30pm - 5:00pm ET

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for an event on the policy decisions shaping America's energy future.

  

 🗓 When:  Tuesday, September 22, 2026 | 10:30am - 12:00pm ET

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for an event about how the travel industry is approaching sustainability.

  

 
 

 🗓 When:  Tuesday, September 22, 2026 | 12:30pm - 2:00pm ET 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for an event on how global sports can accelerate sustainability on and beyond the track. 

 

 
 🗓 When:  Tuesday, September 22, 2026 | 2:00pm - 3:00pm ET

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us for a conversation on the future of water stewardship in a resource-constrained world.

  

 
 🗓 When:  Tuesday, September 22, 2026 | 5:00pm - 7:00pm ET
